pages.text: The Sample Collector is the $(4)starting point$(0) of the whole line: hold it and right-click a creature to draw a Life Sample.$(br2)$(bold)How to use:$(0)$(li)Right-click a life-energy block/pipe to charge: it stores 100,000 and each draw costs 5,000 — 20 draws per full charge$(li)Success = the creature group's base rate + a wounded bonus: +10 below 50% HP, another +10 below 25%, capped at 95%$(li)On failure you keep half the energy, but the sample is lost$(li)Each creature yields at most 3 successful samples$(br2)$(bold)Purity:$(0) draws are skewed — 60% land in the 0-49 bracket. Mediocre blood is the norm, but the Cultivator can $(4)refine$(0) it later.$(br2)Golden rule: beat them near death first, then draw.

pages.title: Creature Groups
pages.text: $(bold)Your group decides a sample's potential:$(0)$(br2)$(li)$(4)Warm-blooded$(0) (farm animals, fish...): base purity 45, collect rate 85%$(li)$(4)Undead$(0) (zombies, skeletons...): 55 / 70%$(li)$(4)Explosive$(0) (creeper): 60 / 55%$(li)$(4)Aberrant$(0) (spiders, slimes, blazes...): 65 / 45%$(li)$(4)Ender$(0) (endermen, shulkers...): 70 / 40%$(li)$(4)Boss$(0) (wither, warden): 85 / 20%$(li)$(4)Dragon$(0) (ender dragon): 90 / 25%$(br2)Matching order: Dragon ＞ Boss ＞ Explosive ＞ Aberrant ＞ Ender ＞ Undead ＞ Warm-blooded.$(br2)Low purity can only grow low-grade organs — hunt stronger prey for high purity, or feed samples into the Cultivator.

The Gene Analyzer $(4)deconstructs$(0) a sample of purity 25+ into a Gene Sequence Fragment.$(br2)$(bold)Costs:$(0)$(li)100 ticks (5 seconds) and 5,000 life energy$(li)Success scales linearly with purity: roughly 70% at purity 25, up to about 95% at purity 100$(li)Win or lose, the sample is always consumed$(br2)Below purity 25 it cannot even be fed in — refine low-purity stock at the Cultivator first.$(br2)This machine is the bottleneck of the line: no sequences, no organs.

A Gene Sequence Fragment is the feedstock of the Structuring Table, and it $(4)keeps the creature source and purity$(0).$(br2)Hand it to the "$(l:akaishi:life_struct)Life Structuring Table$(/l)" to forge an organ.$(br2)$(bold)Purity is value:$(0) higher purity means higher organ integrity, while samples and sequences below 25 are barely worth keeping.$(br2)Keep extra stock in the "Sample Vault" described under "$(l:akaishi:life_vaults)Vaults$(/l)"; purity also unlocks trait tiers — see "$(l:akaishi:trait_safe)Safe Mutations$(/l)".
Suggested order: read "$(l:akaishi:life_struct)Life Structuring Table$(/l)" to forge sequences into organs; vault your spare samples and sequences; trait play is left to the Mutations chapter.
